title: Snowflake
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='ice1' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#a8e6ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#4fc3f7'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='ice2' x1='0' y1='1' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e1f5fe'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#81d4fa'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='ice3' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b3e5fc'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Main six arms -->
  <!-- Vertical arm -->
  <rect x='46' y='14' width='8' height='72' rx='4' fill='url(#ice1)'/>
  <!-- Diagonal arms (rotated) -->
  <rect x='46' y='14' width='8' height='72' rx='4' fill='url(#ice2)' transform='rotate(60 50 50)'/>
  <rect x='46' y='14' width='8' height='72' rx='4' fill='url(#ice2)' transform='rotate(120 50 50)'/>
  <rect x='46' y='14' width='8' height='72' rx='4' fill='url(#ice2)' transform='rotate(-60 50 50)'/>
  <rect x='46' y='14' width='8' height='72' rx='4' fill='url(#ice2)' transform='rotate(-120 50 50)'/>

  <!-- Branch details on each arm (small V shapes) -->
  <!-- Vertical top branch -->
  <rect x='38' y='22' width='5' height='16' rx='2.5' fill='url(#ice3)' transform='rotate(-35 40.5 30)'/>
  <rect x='58' y='22' width='5' height='16' rx='2.5' fill='url(#ice3)' transform='rotate(35 59.5 30)'/>
  <!-- Vertical bottom branch -->
  <rect x='38' y='62' width='5' height='16' rx='2.5' fill='url(#ice3)' transform='rotate(35 40.5 70)'/>
  <rect x='58' y='62' width='5' height='16' rx='2.5' fill='url(#ice3)' transform='rotate(-35 59.5 70)'/>

  <!-- Branch 60deg top-right -->
  <rect x='52' y='22' width='5' height='16' rx='2.5' fill='url(#ice3)' transform='rotate(25 54 38)'/>
  <rect x='72' y='42' width='5' height='16' rx='2.5' fill='url(#ice3)' transform='rotate(85 74 54)'/>
  <!-- Branch 120deg top-left -->
  <rect x='22' y='48' width='5' height='16' rx='2.5' fill='url(#ice3)' transform='rotate(-85 24 62)'/>
  <rect x='28' y='26' width='5' height='16' rx='2.5' fill='url(#ice3)' transform='rotate(-25 30 40)'/>
  <!-- Branch -60deg bottom-right -->
  <rect x='52' y='62' width='5' height='16' rx='2.5' fill='url(#ice3)' transform='rotate(-25 54 70)'/>
  <rect x='72' y='42' width='5' height='16' rx='2.5' fill='url(#ice3)' transform='rotate(-85 74 54)'/>
  <!-- Branch -120deg bottom-left -->
  <rect x='22' y='48' width='5' height='16' rx='2.5' fill='url(#ice3)' transform='rotate(85 24 62)'/>
  <rect x='28' y='62' width='5' height='16' rx='2.5' fill='url(#ice3)' transform='rotate(25 30 70)'/>

  <!-- Center hexagon -->
  <polygon points='50,42 57,46 57,54 50,58 43,54 43,46' fill='url(#ice3)' stroke='#e1f5fe' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Inner glow dot -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='4' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- Small frost tips on each arm end -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='86' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='81' cy='32' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='19' cy='32' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='81' cy='68' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='19' cy='68' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
</svg>
